spec.semantics_python:
# MACC8 rd, rs1, rs2 : acc0 += sext8(rs1[7:0]) * sext8(rs2[7:0]); rd = acc0 (32 bit)
def sem(rs1, rs2, state):
    a = rs1 & 0xFF
    b = rs2 & 0xFF
    if a >= 0x80: a -= 0x100          # sext8
    if b >= 0x80: b -= 0x100          # sext8
    acc = (state.get('acc0', 0) + a * b) & 0xFFFFFFFF   # bao vong 32 bit nhu golden
    state['acc0'] = acc
    return acc, state

# MACC8Z rd, rs1, rs2 : acc0 = sext8(rs1)*sext8(rs2) (dung de xoa + nap hat dau vong)
def sem_init(rs1, rs2, state):
    a = rs1 & 0xFF
    b = rs2 & 0xFF
    if a >= 0x80: a -= 0x100
    if b >= 0x80: b -= 0x100
    acc = (a * b) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    state['acc0'] = acc
    return acc, state

Doc ket qua bang `macc8 rd, x0, x0` (x0=0 nen acc0 khong doi, rd = acc0). Giai phong 1 thanh ghi tam (static.json layers.conv2.loops[1].n_regs_free = 3).

spec.semantics_python:
# RQSET rs1=shift, rs2=zero_point : nap cau hinh (hoisted ra ngoai vong)
def sem_set(rs1, rs2, state):
    state['rq_shift'] = rs1 & 0x3F
    state['rq_zp'] = rs2 & 0xFF
    return 0, state

# RQNT rd, rs1=acc(int32), rs2=multiplier(int32)
def sem(rs1, rs2, state):
    def s32(x):
        return x - 0x100000000 if x >= 0x80000000 else x
    acc = s32(rs1)
    mul = s32(rs2)
    sh = state.get('rq_shift', 0) & 0x3F
    zp = state.get('rq_zp', 0)
    if zp >= 0x80: zp -= 0x100
    p = acc * mul                       # tich 64 bit chinh xac
    if sh > 0:
        p = (p + (1 << (sh - 1))) >> sh # dich phai co dau, lam tron nua len
    y = p + zp
    if y < -128: y = -128               # kep int8
    if y > 127:  y = 127
    return y & 0xFFFFFFFF, state
spec.firmware_changes: Hoist `rqset shift, zp` ra ngoai vong kenh dau ra; thay chuoi requant trong vong (mul + addi lam tron + srai + add zp + max + min) bang mot `rqnt rd, racc, rmul` roi `sb`. Phai sao chep DUNG che do lam tron cua ham requant trong firmware golden; neu golden dung lam tron khac (ví du dich truoc cong) thi sua sem cho khop.

# SDOT4 rd, rs1, rs2 : acc0 += sum_{i=0..3} sext8(rs1 byte i) * sext8(rs2 byte i)
def sem(rs1, rs2, state):
    acc = state.get('acc0', 0)
    for i in range(4):
        a = (rs1 >> (8 * i)) & 0xFF
        b = (rs2 >> (8 * i)) & 0xFF
        if a >= 0x80: a -= 0x100
        if b >= 0x80: b -= 0x100
        acc = (acc + a * b) & 0xFFFFFFFF   # cong mod 2^32: ket hop duoc nen doi thu tu van dung tung bit
    state['acc0'] = acc
    return acc, state

spec.semantics_python:
# PMAX4 rd, rs1, rs2 : rd[byte i] = max(sext8(rs1 byte i), sext8(rs2 byte i)) theo tung lan
def sem(rs1, rs2, state):
    rd = 0
    for i in range(4):
        a = (rs1 >> (8 * i)) & 0xFF
        b = (rs2 >> (8 * i)) & 0xFF
        sa = a - 0x100 if a >= 0x80 else a
        sb = b - 0x100 if b >= 0x80 else b
        m = a if sa >= sb else b
        rd |= (m & 0xFF) << (8 * i)
    return rd & 0xFFFFFFFF, state

encoding.funct3: 0x0 (DOTN: chay) / 0x1 (DSETN: dat so phan tu N) / 0x2 (DSETS: dat buoc cho hai con tro)

spec.semantics_python:
# DSETN rs1=N (so phan tu int8), rs2=0
def sem_setn(rs1, rs2, state):
    state['dot_n'] = rs1 & 0xFFFF
    return 0, state

# DSETS rs1=stride_a (byte), rs2=stride_b (byte, co dau)
def sem_sets(rs1, rs2, state):
    state['dot_sa'] = rs1 & 0xFFFFFFFF
    state['dot_sb'] = rs2 & 0xFFFFFFFF
    return 0, state

# DOTN rd, rs1=ptr_a, rs2=ptr_b : rd = acc0 = sum_{i<N} sext8(mem[a+i*sa]) * sext8(mem[b+i*sb])
# Bo nho truyen trong state['mem'] de ham van la Python thuan.
def sem(rs1, rs2, state):
    def s8(v):
        v &= 0xFF
        return v - 0x100 if v >= 0x80 else v
    n  = state.get('dot_n', 0)
    sa = state.get('dot_sa', 1)
    sb = state.get('dot_sb', 1)
    mem = state['mem']
    acc = 0
    for i in range(n):
        a = (rs1 + i * sa) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        b = (rs2 + i * sb) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        acc = (acc + s8(mem[a]) * s8(mem[b])) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    state['acc0'] = acc
    return acc, state

encoding.funct3: 0x3 (GLOAD: lay 1 tu 4 byte da dong goi tu FIFO) / 0x4 (GSET: base, stride) / 0x5 (GCNT: so byte)

spec.semantics_python:
# GSET rs1=base, rs2=stride (byte, co dau)
def sem_gset(rs1, rs2, state):
    state['g_ptr'] = rs1 & 0xFFFFFFFF
    state['g_str'] = rs2 & 0xFFFFFFFF
    return 0, state

# GCNT rs1=count (so byte se gom)
def sem_gcnt(rs1, rs2, state):
    state['g_cnt'] = rs1 & 0xFFFF
    return 0, state

# GLOAD rd : gom 4 byte ke tiep theo buoc, dong goi little-endian thanh 1 tu
def sem(rs1, rs2, state):
    mem = state['mem']
    p   = state.get('g_ptr', 0)
    st  = state.get('g_str', 1)
    rd  = 0
    for i in range(4):
        rd |= (mem[p & 0xFFFFFFFF] & 0xFF) << (8 * i)
        p = (p + st) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    state['g_ptr'] = p
    state['g_cnt'] = max(0, state.get('g_cnt', 0) - 4)
    return rd & 0xFFFFFFFF, state

encoding.funct3: 0x0 (MACC8) / 0x1 (SDOT4) - cung ma, chon accumulator bang funct7
encoding.funct7: 0x00-0x07 chon acc0..acc7; 0x08-0x0F = bien the khoi tao (acc[i] = tich)

spec.semantics_python:
# MACC8/SDOT4 mo rong: chi so accumulator k lay tu funct7[2:0], truyen qua state['acc_sel']
# SDOT4 rd, rs1, rs2 voi bank: acc[k] += sum_{i<4} sext8(rs1 byte i) * sext8(rs2 byte i)
def sem(rs1, rs2, state):
    k = state.get('acc_sel', 0) & 0x7
    acc = state.setdefault('acc', [0] * 8)
    v = acc[k]
    for i in range(4):
        a = (rs1 >> (8 * i)) & 0xFF
        b = (rs2 >> (8 * i)) & 0xFF
        if a >= 0x80: a -= 0x100
        if b >= 0x80: b -= 0x100
        v = (v + a * b) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    acc[k] = v
    state['acc'] = acc
    return v, state

# ACCRD rd : doc acc[k] ra GPR (funct3 = 0x5)
def sem_rd(rs1, rs2, state):
    k = state.get('acc_sel', 0) & 0x7
    return state.setdefault('acc', [0] * 8)[k], state
